def collate_histories(batch):
    seq, target, history_items = zip(*batch)
    # A trailing sentinel preserves sorted order without adding random draws.
    padded = np.full(
        (len(batch), max(len(h) for h in history_items)),
        np.iinfo(np.int64).max,
        dtype=np.int64,
    )
    for index, h in enumerate(history_items):
        padded[index, :len(h)] = h
    return (
        torch.from_numpy(np.stack(seq)),
        torch.from_numpy(np.stack(target)),
        torch.from_numpy(padded),
    )
